Usually an empty body (rejected before reaching application code); a small number of endpoints can instead throw an application-level auth.* error that carries the ApiErrorResponse envelope (see the 'default' response).

403.description: The authenticated caller does not satisfy this endpoint's authorization policy. Usually an empty body (rejected by the authorization middleware); some endpoints instead throw an application-level forbidden.* error (e.g. no workspace selected, user not linked to a customer) that carries the ApiErrorResponse envelope (see the 'default' response).

default.description: Error response for any status code not documented explicitly above. Follows the shared ApiErrorResponse envelope.

parameters.name: X-Workspace-Id
parameters.description: Workspace to operate against. Optional: falls back to the workspace claim on the access token, or to the user's only workspace when they belong to just one.
